mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees and partly cloudy by Badger Ridge Middle School. The overnight low will be 55 degrees with no rain predicted. If you are a night owl, look for the waxing gibbous moon and the space station passing overhead at 3:24 AM, appearing near Mount Horeb and moving toward the Fitchburg and Madison area about halfway up the sky.

City news today focuses on your wallet and your career. The Common Council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover rising maintenance costs, which may increase your quarterly bill by about 26 dollars. Also, the Public Works department is currently hiring an Engineering Technician to help manage city infrastructure.

There is plenty to do, with live music happening today at Baileys Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Also, make sure to check out the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today at the Capitol, and look forward to a free girls hockey event happening tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.

In a report from last Friday, Verona police arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after officers found her passed out behind the wheel of her vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.

Treat yourself to today's flavor, Raspberry Cheesecake, at Culver's before they close at 10:30 PM. For even more cool treats today, Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 5 PM and at the Verona Area High School stadium from 1 PM to 7:30 PM.
